self_time_mechanisms.name: Memory planning, schema and snapshot validation
Memory planning, schema and snapshot validation

same_pid_jit_object_verification.scope: Actual executable bytes from the same owned process sampled for CPU self time, captured only after sampling; original Object provenance exact. No timing scores or hardware retirement counts.

complete_instruction_binding.scope: Every executable byte matches its genuine Object except explicitly decoded BL relocations, whose actual destinations must equal captured named JIT functions in the same PID. No code is executed from an Object.

interpretation.scope: Optimization15 diagnosis only; accepted53. No holdout profiling, tuning or benchmark selection; official performance observations0.
interpretation.sample_scope: Warm checked-call residence includes output reset/drop. Fractions are statistical self-time attribution, not exact frozen timer shares, hardware retirement counters, IPC/cache events or memory traffic.
interpretation.complete_code_binding: Both complete numeric functions are byte-identical to genuine Objects (19464B G,7608B D). Each caller differs only at one expected4-byte BL relocation; every nonrelocation byte matches and each actual decoded call resolves exactly to the captured numeric function address in that same sampled PID. All recorded hot windows match byte-for-byte.
interpretation.source_corroboration: numeric_map::emit_with_selection declares fold as I64 and routes each F64Add through the raw-word primitive wrapper. The primitive bitcasts both words to F64 and the result back to I64. The shared f64_arithmetic helper already emits the same strict typed F64Add used by product/sum kernels.
interpretation.selected_next_work: Use a typed F64 SSA accumulator only for proved F64 map reductions, seed original +0 and keep every term/add/order unchanged. Convert term words at use and serialize the final accumulator back to the existing raw-word fold boundary. Reuse common strict F64 arithmetic, retain a private word-accumulator ablation, all original read/scalar errors, views, scratch, owners/caps/replay/fees/visits and ABI. No new runtime frame/state or source rewrite.
interpretation.different_from_prior_failures: Rejected41 direct SSA map composition still declared an I64 fold and used word F64Add, as verified at source1f75711d3b8ca715abf0b9e74738a061c20110f3. This removes per-term accumulator register-class transport; it does not repeat old bounds hoisting, frame adapter composition or duplicate-read reuse. No observed fingerprint is retried.

source_derived_terms_on_unchanged_inputs.scope: Derived original source term counts and verified loop instructions; final ABI serialization and input-value conversions remain. Not a hardware-event measurement or speedup forecast.

interpretation.limits: A materially changed fully qualified source must pass one prospective optimization probe and frozen formal v4 gate. No runtime/generalization gain is inferred from the profile or instruction count alone.
